typed_core.universe_rule: exclude <unannotated> from source, relay, and target

relay_strict.universe_rule: allow boundary <unannotated> endpoints but exclude <unannotated> as relay

coverage_inclusive.universe_rule: retain every release-native label, including concrete bodies grouped as <unannotated>

typed_core.semantics: direct body-level edges count as depth 1; depth 2 requires a shared concrete middle body; larger microscopic depths are not computed

relay_strict.semantics: direct body-level edges count as depth 1; depth 2 requires a shared concrete middle body; larger microscopic depths are not computed

coverage_inclusive.semantics: direct body-level edges count as depth 1; depth 2 requires a shared concrete middle body; larger microscopic depths are not computed

semantics.M_ijk: A_ij > 0 and A_jk > 0 in the observed sector support
semantics.L_ijk: exists one concrete middle body with an incoming i edge and outgoing k edge
semantics.Path_2_quotient: Boolean support of the sector product A^2; existential edges may use different concrete middle bodies
semantics.Route_2[Y_MaleCNS]: support of the projected product Q_k Y_MaleCNS Q_j Y_MaleCNS Q_i; for the declared nonnegative node-basis carrier this is witnessed by one concrete middle body v
semantics.D_quotient_support: shortest directed-path distance on the sector support graph; this is the quantity formerly labelled D_route in the baseline aggregate
semantics.D_route[Y_MaleCNS]: only a depth-2 cutoff comparison is computed here; larger depths are UNREACHED_AT_CUTOFF rather than infinity
semantics.descent_claim: A sector path does not imply a liftable microscopic path without a shared-intermediate witness or an explicit lumpability theorem
